'''Maridun''' was the grassy and forested [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Maridun went unnoticed for many millennia, and so was considered a haven by those who knew of of its existence. The planet came to support a colony of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] who sought to escape the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was the site of a [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|battle]] when [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to test an [[Defoliator/Legends|experimental weapon]]. Amani could be found on the planet of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], where many of them were refugees from Maridun.

The planet was officially discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]] after the [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] made contact with them. The Empire created several mining colonies on the planet. When the Empire reduced its presence following the [[Battle of Maridun (0 ABY)|Battle of Maridun]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] moved in and enslaved much of the planet.

==Description==
[[File:Amani_1a.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A tribe of Amanin on Maridun]]
A temperate world of rolling, grassy plains and forested meadows, the planet Maridun remained largely devoid of permanent settlements until the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="UAA" /> Wildlife native to Maridun included [[Bird/Legends|birds]], herd animals, dangerous predatory animals called [[Charnoq/Legends|charnoqs]], [[Mastiff phalone/Legends|mastiff phalones]], [[Carrier butterfly/Legends|carrier butterflies]], [[Fwit/Legends|fwits]], and enormous lumbering [[Corinathoth/Legends|corinathoths]].

==History==
[[File:Lurmen_village.png|thumb|left|200px|A Lurmen village]]
Maridun was a subject world of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], though any and all traces of that long-forgotten government had disappeared by the time explorers first came upon the planet during the millennium surrounding the blazing of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Those who first visited the planet quickly found the native [[Amani/Legends|Amanin]] to be frightening and vicious, and no known colonies were established during the time before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While not directly involved in any early conflicts with the Republic, Maridun was located in space controlled by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and later the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic, a colony of [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] was established on the planet.<ref name="JC" /> As the Lurmen were pacifists, Maridun's neutrality and independence offered them a haven from the war,<ref name="JC" /><ref name="DOP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref> which had quickly spread<ref name="TEA" /> to their [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|lurmen|Lurmen}}</ref> a Republic target because of its affiliation with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].<ref name="TCWEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Led by village elder [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]], the Lurmen erected a strongly pacifist society; nevertheless, the war was brought to them when a Republic cruiser carrying members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] crash-landed on the planet after a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunction. In hopes of aiding an injured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] sought out the Lurmen settlement.<ref name="JC" /> As the Jedi began the recovery process, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] landed on the planet and claimed to represent a peaceful government interested in saving the Lurmen from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic. Maridun was, in fact, a prime location to test fire the [[Defoliator/Legends|Defoliator]] weapon the Confederacy had just constructed. Kaa nearly accepted the Lurmen "destiny" to be destroyed by this weapon, but the recovered Jedi went against his orders to leave the planet and set up a shield defense around the village. During the ensuing [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|battle]], the Jedi disabled the Defoliator and captured Durd.<ref name="DOP" />

[[File:Trenchwarfare-Empire18.png|thumb|right|300px|Imperial forces entrenched on Maridun fight incoming Amani.]]
Years after the war, using old data files on the planet, the Empire officially annexed the world in [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]] and established a mining operation on the planet. While the Imperial occupation went unperturbed for its first decade, the tribal Amanin rose up in defiance of the Imperial invaders and attacked the colony. As the casualties mounted, Imperial officer [[Janek Sunber/Legends|Janek Sunber]], who had taken the command of the Imperial forces following the death of General [[Ziering]], discovered the Amanin concept of [[takital]] and that they were an intelligent species capable of negotiating. Following a bloody [[Battle of Maridun (0 ABY)|battle]], the Imperials made a deal with an Amanin lorekeeper in which his tribe would help [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] traders capture Amanin from other tribes as slaves.<ref name="E16" />

Following the Imperial victory on Maridun, the battle became something of a legend amongst Imperial infantry, the Imperial propaganda machine having made the battle into a heroic struggle for survival&mdash;and of course, a success&mdash;from the display of officer ineptitude it had in fact been. After the Empire moved its attention towards other [[Star system/Legends|systems]], smaller private interests, especially those associated with criminals like the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], began to take control of the slave trade. After only a few years of Imperial and private slave trading, Amanin were spread through much of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some of these Amanin returned to Maridun with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other advanced technology, taking control of local tribes. As cities began forming around old Imperial [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], the planet quickly became a hideout for those hoping to avoid local law enforcement in neighboring star systems.<ref name="UAA" />

Following the fall of the Empire, Maridun was located in space controlled by [[Zsinj's Empire]]. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the galaxy, Maridun was cut off from the rest of civilization and controlled by the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] from [[27 ABY/Legends|27]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] until the Yuuzhan Vong were defeated and driven from the worlds they had conquered.<ref name="TEA" />
